sources.reason: Reuse the installed one-exchange ModelTransport contract; compose and bound exact bytes before its single send. No tools, streaming publication or model loop.
Reuse existing answer admission/ledger managed payloads and fenced markSending. Adapt capture-before-settlement ordering without copying or adding a runtime journal.

Adapt separate trusted policy and untrusted history/input/evidence composition, bounded generation and saved-response settlement. Direct answer uses core fresh disclosure and full trusted Scope; no Chatom persistence imported.
Live event batching/replay does not implement bounded no-resend answer generation. Existing answer ledger remains the only direct-answer journal.
Embedding is not a chat transport. Automatic retry, key rotation, fallback and raw error logging contradict this flow. Reuse the already qualified local PSR18 request serializer instead.
Adapt negative crash/recovery scenarios to immutable unknown dispatch, no resend and observation/response persistence failure; never reopen model generation for unknown work.

No donor provides the complete scoped all-content grounding contract. New typed evidence views, citation subset validation and stable-key observation settlement connect these existing boundaries without importing donor runtimes.
